rules.says: Once an invoice is issued, its amount never changes.
rules.mutant: an issued invoice's amount is changed in place, and the company is billed twice for different sums

rules.says: An assignment goes from draft to issued to withdrawn. It never goes back.
rules.mutant: an issued assignment is put back to draft and edited, so nobody can tell what the learner had been given

rules.says: Only a coach may issue an assignment.
rules.mutant: a learner issues their own assignment

rules.says: A cohort holds at most twenty learners.
rules.mutant: two learners are added to a cohort of nineteen at the same moment, and both get in
